content.comment_body: We have lost the original installation media. Is it possible to install [product_name] on an upgraded laptop without the DVD? If not, what are the steps to obtain a replacement installation medium?

To install [product_name], you require the original CD or DVD. Without this, installation is not possible. Updates can only be applied if a previous version of [product_name] is already installed. The licensed version is not available for direct download from [company_name] websites, only updates are downloadable. You will need to purchase a DVD.

Hello [user_name], Since the license for [product_name] is tied to the DVD, you should reach out to [company_name] to check if they can help recover or provide access to your license. Meanwhile, you can use the demo version, but keep in mind it only allows you to work on projects locally and does not permit transferring projects to [product_name] hardware.

For [product_name], there is no license recovery process like with some other platforms. [company_name] cannot recover a lost [product_name] license because it is only present on the original install medium.

To get [product_name] installed, you will need the original DVD. For upgrades, you must either have [product_name] already installed or insert the original DVD when prompted during installation. The advantage is that any version of [product_name] can be upgraded, regardless of its age, so consider obtaining an earlier version online if possible. Alternatively, as suggested above, you can purchase a new version from [company_name]. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges reinstalling [product_name] due to its licensing mechanism that requires the original physical DVD medium. Licensed installation files are unavailable for download from [company_name], so users must possess the original media, making recovery after loss or hardware changes difficult.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to reinstall [product_name] without the original DVD or find a way to obtain replacement installation media or license without making another purchase.
